title: CAN I HAVE
note: Cue times are COMPUTED from sample partitions of the supplied take-2 master + added silence (gap). Only silence is ever added; speech is never sped up, trimmed or cut. Phrase boundaries come from measured silences in this build; mapping to script phrases is structural, corroborated by independent ASR evidence, and unverified by ear. Take 2 is a provisional longer alternative selected during production (not an owner audition or owner selection).

cues.text: Una frase para practicar en casa.
Can I have some water, please?
¿Me das un poco de agua, por favor?
Mamás y papás: manden NIÑOS por mensaje privado.

alignment.method: cut positions derived by this build from the waveform: integer sample midpoints of measured silences (silencedetect -38 dB, >= 120 ms) between declared groups of speech islands; NOT an externally supplied sample-cut handoff

confidence.phraseBoundaries: waveform-derived cuts from this build (silence midpoints); mapping island group -> script phrase is structural. Independent faster-whisper small/medium ASR (supplied later, see manifest/batch1_inputs/asr_handoff) corroborates the broad phrase assignment; ASR is not listening and does not prove pronunciation or naturalness
confidence.islands: measured from waveform (-38 dB); not a linguistic detector
confidence.wordLevel: not measured by this build; ASR word estimates carry model uncertainty (por/for code-switch disagreement in medium CanHave)
